WITH round_stats AS (
  SELECT
    "District",
    "State",
    "Survey Round",
    AVG("Women age 15-49 years who are literate (%)") AS avg_literacy

  WHERE "Women age 15-49 years who are literate (%)" IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY "District", "State", "Survey Round"
),

  FROM round_stats
)
